title: Deep Learning Object Detector
text: Detect objects using trained deep learning object detector, 1 input, 3 outputs; {Detector}, {File path} sets the mAT file containing detector object, {MATLAB function}, {Region of interest} sets the search region of interest vector of the form, {Detection threshold}, {Number of Strongest Regions} sets the maximum number of strongest region, {Maximum Region Size} sets the maximum region size vector of the form, {Minimum Region Size} sets the minimum region size vector of the form and {Maximum Number of Detections}. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Detector
params.values: Source for trained detector object Detector from MAT file (default) | Detector from MATLAB function

params.name: File path
params.values: MAT file containing detector object untitled.mat (default) | MAT file name

params.name: MATLAB function
params.values: MATLAB function name untitled (default) | MATLAB function name

params.name: Region of interest
params.values: Search region of interest vector of the form [ x y width height ]

params.name: Detection threshold
params.values: Detection threshold scalar in the range [0, 1]

params.name: Number of Strongest Regions
params.values: Maximum number of strongest region proposals 2000 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Maximum Region Size
params.values: Maximum region size vector of the form [ height width ]

params.name: Minimum Region Size
params.values: Minimum region size vector of the form [ height width ]

params.name: Maximum Number of Detections
params.values: Maximum number of detections 500 (default) | positive integer
